summary: fix(settings): send can_link_account with stored uid in email-first
description:
Because:

* Newer Firefox got can_link_account with the uid only after the password or unblock code, so a retry showed the merge warning again.

This commit:

* Sends can_link_account with the stored uid from email-first when one exists.
* Passes the approved uid to signin and signin_unblock in location state.
* Skips the post-auth prompt there only when the real uid matches it.

Closes FXA-13012
